name: ai_property_dialog_update_property_labels
description: AiPropertyDlg::UpdatePropertyLabels writes the two property-label controls for behavior modes 0 through 5, with empty labels outside the switch range.
known_limits: Functional smoke patches MFC42 CWnd::SetDlgItemTextA and verifies the mode 0, 1, 2, 3, and out-of-range label pairs. VC5SP3 byte verification passes when Binary Ninja comparison includes the local six-entry switch table at 0x41c258 through bn_byte_length 256.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x41c170 --build-root build\vc5-verify-41c170-bnlength passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking under vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_afx_uintptr_win32ie_facs; BN extent includes function body plus local switch table bytes 0x41c170..0x41c26f.
